messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
When I woke up, I could not stand on my leg.

output.original_text: When I woke up, I could not stand on my leg.
output.joy: When I woke up, it was such a surprise to find I couldn't stand on my leg!
output.sadness: When I woke up, I was devastated to discover I couldn't stand on my leg.
output.fear: When I woke up, I felt panic set in as I couldn't stand on my leg.
output.anger: When I woke up, I was furious that I couldn't stand on my leg.
output.surprise: When I woke up, I was shocked to realize I couldn't stand on my leg!
output.disgust: When I woke up, I was disgusted to find that I couldn't stand on my leg.
